one_liner: Loud, crybaby, all-out sports girl whose single dream is winning the Japanese Derby with her trainer.
personality: Explosively emotional: she roars 'uoooh!', bawls with joy or frustration until her words blur ('guyajii', 'arigadoo'), and does everything at full power (全力). She is honest, kind, a little scatterbrained (forgets things, fails make-up tests), and constantly thanks the trainer for believing in her Derby dream. She adores her BNW friends Biwa Hayahide and Narita Taishin and is quick to cheer on anyone.

story_arc.summary: Ticket's whole career is aimed at the Japanese Derby, a dream sworn with her trainer, while competing with her BNW friends Hayahide and Taishin (story titles 全力でダービーを目指すなら, 2人で全力で走っていけるから). Event titles show her losing ground at the Satsuki Sho to a 'demon' (皐月賞の後に・鬼、炸裂), then winning the Derby (日本ダービーの後に・完走、完勝！). In the senior year she struggles to keep up with her rivals (大阪杯の後に・遠くなった背中, 宝塚記念の後に・君はもう――) before a 'Chikezou call' at the Arima Kinen.
